# ToolsRail

> > ToolsRail is a comprehensive online toolkit providing calculators, converters, and generators for mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics, and web development.

ToolsRail offers browser-based educational tools with real-time calculations, visual previews, and step-by-step solutions. The platform covers unit conversions (metric-imperial), geometry calculators, CSS generators, statistical analysis, and random generators—all designed for students, engineers, developers, and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Unit conversion (metric-imperial)
- Geometry calculators
- CSS generators and typography
- Statistical analysis (regression, Gini coefficient)
- Physics calculators (pressure, energy)
- Electrical engineering (power consumption, capacitance)
- Biology and ecology tools
- Random generators (binary, sentences, timers)
- Chart visualization (Chart.js)
- Browser-based tools (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge)
- Educational step-by-step solutions
- SI system and aviation units (Mach, knots)
- Data size and speed conversions
- JavaScript-powered calculators

## Unit Converters

- [Speed Converter Tool - Free Online Unit Converter | km/h to mph, m/s, knots](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/speed-converter.php): Speed converter: m/s, km/h, mph, knots, Mach with educational explanations
- [Data Size Converter – Convert Between B, KB, MB, GB, TB, and More](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/data-size-converter.php): Data storage converter: bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB with download time calculator
- [Energy Unit Converter with Explanations | J, kWh, kcal, BTU, eV Calculator & Learning Guide](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/energy-converter.php): Energy converter: Joules, kWh, kcal, BTU, eV with learning guide
- [Airspeed Converter: Knots to Mach, m/s, km/h, mph, ft/s | Aviation & Engineering Tool](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/airspeed-converter.php): Aviation airspeed converter: knots, Mach, m/s, km/h, mph, ft/s
- [Construction Material Density Converter: Tool for Builders, Engineers & DIY](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/construction-material-density-converter.php): Construction material density converter: kg/m³, lb/ft³, g/cm³ for building
- [Capacitance Charge Calculator: Convert Q=C×V | Farads, Coulombs, Volts Conversion](https://www.toolsrail.com/unit-converters/electrical-capacitance-charge-converter.php): Electrical capacitance charge calculator using Q=C×V formula for circuits

## Geometry & Mathematics Calculators

- [Pythagorean Theorem Calculator - Step-by-Step Solution with Chart](https://www.toolsrail.com/geometry/pythagorean-theorem-calculator.php): Pythagorean Theorem calculator with visual diagrams and step-by-step solutions
- [Circular Sector Calculator: Area, Arc Length & Perimeter | Toolsrail Geometry](https://www.toolsrail.com/geometry/sector-calculator.php): Interactive circular sector calculator with step-by-step solutions

## Statistics & Data Analysis

- [Multiple Linear Regression Calculator with Step-by-Step Learning Guide | Statistics Tool](https://www.toolsrail.com/statistics/multiple-linear-regression-calculator.php): Multiple linear regression calculator with R², residuals, and CSV export
- [Gini Coefficient Calculator – Measure Inequality of a Distribution](https://www.toolsrail.com/statistics/gini-coefficient-calculator.php): Gini coefficient calculator with Lorenz curve for inequality measurement

## Physics & Engineering Tools

- [Pressure Calculator: Physics Tool for Force/Area & Fluid Pressure | ToolsRail](https://www.toolsrail.com/physics/pressure-calculator.php): Physics pressure calculator for force/area and fluid pressure using Pascal's Law
- [Electric Power Consumption & Energy Cost Calculator | ToolsRail](https://www.toolsrail.com/electric-engineering/electric-power-consumption-calculator.php): Electrical power consumption and kWh cost calculator for appliances

## CSS & Web Development

- [CSS Text Formatter & Generator Tool - Real-time Typography Styling](https://www.toolsrail.com/css/css-text-formatter.php): CSS typography generator with real-time preview and browser compatibility

## Charts & Visualization

- [Free Pie Chart Generator Tool | Create Proportional Visualizations](https://www.toolsrail.com/charts/pie-chart-generator.php): Pie chart generator using Chart.js for data visualization and reports

## Biology & Ecology Tools

- [Cell Size Comparison Tool: Visual Scale from Atoms to Cells | Biology Education](https://www.toolsrail.com/biology/cell-size-comparison-visualizer.php): Interactive biology visualizer comparing atoms, viruses, bacteria, and cells
- [Biodiversity Index Calculator – Shannon, Simpson, Evenness Indices | Ecology Tool](https://www.toolsrail.com/biology/biodiversity-index-calculator.php): Ecology biodiversity calculator: Shannon, Simpson, and Evenness indices

## Random Generators

- [Random Timer Generator: Unpredictable Countdowns for Training & Games | ToolsRail](https://www.toolsrail.com/random/random-timer-generator.php): Random countdown timer for workouts, games, and Pomodoro training
- [Random Binary Generator Tool - Custom Bits [4 to 256] | ToolsRail](https://www.toolsrail.com/random/generator-binary-numbers.php): Random binary sequence generator (4-256 bits) for testing and education
- [Random Sentence Generator: Create Custom Sentences for Writing & Learning](https://www.toolsrail.com/random/random-sentence-generator.php): Random sentence generator for writing practice and language learning
- [Random Coin Flip Simulator: Fair Virtual Coin Toss Tool](https://www.toolsrail.com/random/random-coin-flip.php): Virtual coin flip simulator using JavaScript Math.random() for fair decisions
